observations.statement: The Poki SDK handles ad delivery and gameplay tracking.
observations.excerpt: The Poki SDK connects your game to the platform. It handles ad delivery, gameplay tracking, and the tools you need to test and optimize.

observations.statement: gameLoadingFinished() must fire when loading completes and is required to track loading and conversion to play.
observations.excerpt: gameLoadingFinished() : fire when loading completes. Required to track loading and show your conversion to play.

observations.statement: commercialBreak() should be fired at natural stops before returning to gameplay; not every call triggers an ad.
observations.excerpt: commercialBreak() : fire at natural stops, whenever the player is about to head back into gameplay. Not every call triggers an ad; our system decides when a player is ready, so signal as many opportunities as possible.

observations.statement: rewardedBreak() fires on the player's explicit choice and resets the ad timer.
observations.excerpt: rewardedBreak() : fire on the player's explicit choice to watch an ad for a reward. Make it clear beforehand that an ad is coming. A rewarded break resets the ad timer, so players won't immediately see another ad.
